author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.105 shipped: Config-flow timing logs at debug; warn only on slow steps
summary: Config-flow timing logs at debug; warn only on slow steps
why: Perf audit measured every config/options step under 20 ms live, so the always-on WARNING enter/exit lines were noise that also hid real slowness. Kept the instrumentation (dead≠delete; it is the diagnostic for the original slow-onboarding report) but moved it to DEBUG with one WARNING above a 250 ms module constant (rung 1: a diagnostic threshold should change by reviewed edit). Chose not to add more instrumentation; HA's profiler covers deep dives. Orchestrator review on the small diff; builder mutation-verified the threshold boundary.
implications: Shipped CONFIG-FLOW-SLOW-ONBOARDING-1 at v5.103.105; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.105.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: After restart, open a room options flow; HA log shows no CFLOW-TIMING WARNING for steps under 250 ms

refs.release_notes: Config-flow step timing lines (CFLOW-TIMING) now log at DEBUG; a single WARNING is logged only when a step takes longer than 250 ms (CFLOW_SLOW_MS). Removes per-step warning noise from the HA log.
